CustomAnimation.name: GlowAnimation
CustomAnimation.UpdateFunction: progress = ZO_EaseInQuadratic(progress) local control = self:GetAnimatedControl() local logo = control:GetNamedChild("Logo") local glow = control:GetNamedChild("LogoGlow") local c = zo_lerp(0.75, 1, progress) logo:SetColor(c, c, c, 1) glow:SetBlendMode(1) glow:SetAlpha(0.5 * progress) glow:SetTextureSampleProcessingWeight(TEX_SAMPLE_PROCESSING_WEIGHT, 1 + 0.65 * progress)

CustomAnimation.name: GlowAnimation
CustomAnimation.UpdateFunction: progress = ZO_EaseInOutQuadratic(progress) local control = self:GetAnimatedControl() control:SetVertexColors(1 + 2, zo_lerp(0.1, 0.0, progress), zo_lerp(0.2, 0.1, progress), zo_lerp(0.2, 0.1, progress), 1) control:SetVertexColors(4 + 8, zo_lerp(0.0, 0.1, progress), zo_lerp(0.1, 0.25, progress), zo_lerp(0.1, 0.25, progress), 1)

Control.name: PriorityMail_Badge
Control.OnInitialized: self.label = self:GetNamedChild("BadgeLabel") self.SetText = function(self, text) self.label:SetText(text) end self.SetColor = function(self, r, g, b, a) self:GetNamedChild("BadgeCenter"):SetColor(r, g, b, a) self:GetNamedChild("BadgeLeft"):SetColor(r, g, b, a) self:GetNamedChild("BadgeRight"):SetColor(r, g, b, a) end self.SetTextColor = function(self, r, g, b, a) self.label:SetColor(r, g, b, a) end self:SetColor(1, 0, 0, 1) self:SetTextColor(1, 1, 1, 1)

Control.name: PriorityMail_QueuedRow
Control.OnInitialized: self.to = self:GetNamedChild("To") self.subject = self:GetNamedChild("Subject") self.attachedGold = self:GetNamedChild("AttachedGold") self.attachedGoldIcon = self:GetNamedChild("AttachedGoldIcon") self.backdrop = self:GetNamedChild("Backdrop") self.backdrop:SetVertexColors(1 + 2, 0.1, 0.2, 0.2, 1) self.backdrop:SetVertexColors(4 + 8, 0.0, 0.1, 0.1, 1) self.mouseEnterAnimation = ANIMATION_MANAGER:CreateTimelineFromVirtual("PriorityMail_QueuedRow_MouseEnterAnimation", self.backdrop) self.SetMail = function(self, mail) self.mail = mail self.to:SetText(mail.to or "") self.subject:SetText(mail.subject or "") local gold = 0 if gold and gold ~= 0 then self.attachedGold:SetText(tostring(mail.gold)) self.attachedGoldIcon:SetHidden(false) else self.attachedGold:SetText("") self.attachedGoldIcon:SetHidden(true) end end
Control.OnMouseEnter: local mail = self.mail if mail and mail.body then local sent if mail.sent then local sentDate, sentTime = FormatAchievementLinkTimestamp(mail.sent) if type(sentDate) == "string" then sent = string.format("Initially sent: |cffffff%s at %s|r\n", sentDate, sentTime) end end local attempts if mail.attempts then attempts = string.format("Attempted deliveries: |cffffff%d|r\n", mail.attempts) end local tooltip = string.format("%s%s|cffffff%s", sent or "", attempts or "", mail.body) ZO_Tooltips_ShowTextTooltip(self, LEFT, tooltip) end self.mouseEnterAnimation:PlayForward()
Control.OnMouseExit: if self.mail then ZO_Tooltips_HideTextTooltip() end self.mouseEnterAnimation:PlayBackward()

Label.name: $(parent)Cancel
Label.OnMouseDown: local mail = self:GetParent().mail if mail then PRIORITY_MAIL:DequeueMail(mail) PRIORITY_MAIL:ShowAlert(string.format("Canceled delivery of |cffffff%s|r to |cffffff%s|r", mail.subject or "(no subject)", mail.to or "")) end

TopLevelControl.name: PriorityMail_MailQueue
TopLevelControl.OnInitialized: self.alerts = {} self.nextAlert = 0 self.expanded = true self.isEmpty = true self.alertAnimation = ANIMATION_MANAGER:CreateTimelineFromVirtual("PriorityMail_MailQueue_AlertAnimation", self:GetNamedChild("Alert")) self.mouseEnterAnimation = ANIMATION_MANAGER:CreateTimelineFromVirtual("PriorityMail_MailQueue_MouseEnterAnimation", self) self.badge = self:GetNamedChild("LogoCountBadge") self:GetNamedChild("Alert").toggleControl = true self:GetNamedChild("Logo").toggleControl = true self:GetNamedChild("LogoGlow").toggleControl = true self:GetNamedChild("EmptyQueue").determinateControl = true self:GetNamedChild("Heading").determinateControl = true self:GetNamedChild("ScrollContainer").determinateControl = true self.UpdateAlerts = function(self) local now = GetFrameTimeMilliseconds() if self.nextAlert > now then EVENT_MANAGER:RegisterForUpdate("PriorityMail_UpdateAlerts", 250, function() self:UpdateAlerts() end) return end local message = table.remove(self.alerts, 1) local control = self:GetNamedChild("Alert") if message then self.nextAlert = now + 4000 self.alertAnimation:PlayFromStart() control:SetText(message) else self.alertAnimation:PlayInstantlyToStart() control:SetText("") EVENT_MANAGER:UnregisterForUpdate("PriorityMail_UpdateAlerts") end end self.ShowAlert = function(self, message) table.insert(self.alerts, message) self:UpdateAlerts() end self.ExpandCollapse = function(self) self.expanded = not self.expanded for controlIndex = 1, self:GetNumChildren() do local child = self:GetChild(controlIndex) if not child.toggleControl then if self.expanded then child:SetHidden(child.determinateControl) else child:SetHidden(true) end end end local logo = self:GetNamedChild("Logo") local alert = self:GetNamedChild("Alert") alert:ClearAnchors() if self.expanded then alert:SetAnchor(BOTTOMRIGHT, logo, TOPRIGHT, -12, 0) PRIORITY_MAIL:RefreshMailQueue() else alert:SetAnchor(RIGHT, logo, LEFT, -20, 0) self:RefreshSize() end end self.SetEmpty = function(self, isEmpty) self.isEmpty = isEmpty self:RefreshEmpty() end self.RefreshEmpty = function(self) if self.expanded then self:GetNamedChild("EmptyQueue"):SetHidden(not self.isEmpty) self:GetNamedChild("Heading"):SetHidden(self.isEmpty) self:GetNamedChild("ScrollContainer"):SetHidden(self.isEmpty) end self:RefreshSize() end self.RefreshSize = function(self) zo_callLater(function() local scrollHeight = self:GetNamedChild("ScrollContainerScrollChild"):GetHeight() local height = self.isEmpty and 100 or zo_clamp(80 + scrollHeight, 100, 500) self:SetHeight(height) end, 200) end self:ExpandCollapse()
